items: Stricter anti-paper-leak law; fast-track courts; penalty 5-10 yrs (individuals)
Protected zones (5 km radius) around 250+ yr-old institutions
Registrations 1-2 yrs after event need DM/SDM/EM approval
Udyam Portal gets statutory permanence; 9.16 crore MSMEs registered (up from 1.65 crore in 2023)
Phased mandate from Oct 1, 2028 (already-fitted vehicles: Oct 1, 2027 — see Section 4)

blocks.content: ⚠️ Note: The framework's PIB source PDFs were not supplied separately in either August batch — items above were sourced from the national/regulatory news feeds, not a dedicated PIB compilation. Please share a PIB-specific source if you want this section built out further.
